transfers.mechanism: Equation manipulation and equality-preserving transformations support rearranging and interpreting physics relationships and formulae.
transfers.rationale: A learner fluent in algebra can focus more attention on the physical model instead of getting blocked by symbolic manipulation.

transfers.mechanism: Ratios, proportions and unit reasoning support quantitative relationships in chemistry and measurement contexts.
transfers.rationale: Proportional reasoning is reused across scientific quantities; specific chemistry applications require their own concepts.

transfers.mechanism: Knowledge of organs, tissues and spatial organisation provides prior context for understanding physiological processes and biological structure-function relationships.
transfers.rationale: Anatomical knowledge can make overlapping human-biology concepts easier to interpret; it does not replace broader biology study.

transfers.mechanism: Hypothesis testing, variable control and evidence evaluation reinforce research literacy.
transfers.rationale: Both domains require distinguishing claims from observations and judging the strength of support.

transfers.mechanism: Retrieval practice and feedback can improve durable learning across different subject domains.
transfers.rationale: This is a general learning method, not a subject-specific prerequisite.

transfers.mechanism: Algorithmic decomposition supports reasoning about embedded-system behaviour and control logic.
transfers.rationale: Software and hardware systems often interact, but neither domain is reducible to the other.

transfers.mechanism: Clear explanations support customer discovery, offers, sales conversations and stakeholder communication.
transfers.rationale: Communication skill transfers, while ethical sales and customer research require additional domain-specific capabilities.
